card.name: Small words in timing phrases
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "of", "recent", "last") right after a time span plus "after", "following" or "from", as in "within 14 days following the". Also "care" in "treat per standard of care".

modes.label: Timing link words
modes.description: A short word after a time span and a preposition, just before a dose, start or administration term.
modes.example: During or within 14 days following<< the>> administration of monoamine oxidase inhibitors •

modes.label: Standard of care
modes.description: The word "care" ending the phrase "treat per standard of care" after a hypersensitivity reaction.
